data: What is the morph with the highest average morphological complexity?

The figure shows a horizontal bar chart representing the morphological ranking of morphs based on their textual morph complexity. The abscissa (x-axis) represents the average morphological complexity, while the ordinate (y-axis) lists different morphs. The bars extend horizontally from left to right, indicating increasing morphological complexity. 

From the visual analysis, the longest bar corresponds to the morph "3rd ps sg s," which extends furthest to the right on the x-axis, indicating the highest average morphological complexity among all listed morphs. Therefore, the morph with the highest average morphological complexity is "3rd ps sg s."
